Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework.assertions

Interface LightkeeperAssertions.RetryingAssertion

Enclosing class:
LightkeeperAssertions
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface LightkeeperAssertions.RetryingAssertion
An assertion that LightkeeperAssertions.eventually(Duration, RetryingAssertion) re-runs until it passes.

    • run

      void run() throws Exception
      Runs the assertion once.
      Throws:
      Exception - Assertion failures surface as AssertionError and are retried; any other failure is wrapped in an IllegalStateException (with the original as its cause) and fails fast.
